caption: The drawing depicts a single doll-like figure centrally positioned on a plain, light beige background. The figure has light blonde hair styled in a rounded shape and pale skin. It wears a blue dress with a fitted bodice and flared, pleated skirt that ends at the knees. The dress has elbow-length sleeves with brownish cuffs and a dark collar detail at the neck. Around the waist, there is a striped apron featuring alternating light and dark vertical stripes with a horizontal striped border at the bottom. The figure’s arms and legs show joint lines, suggesting a wooden or articulated construction, and the hands and forearms appear tan or light brown. The legs are exposed below the knee and end in calf-high, green shoes. The overall composition is symmetrical, with the figure standing upright and facing forward, occupying the center of the drawing with ample empty space surrounding it.
title: Pewter Doll
